# S15 try positions: `?` in a for post clause and in a switch
# expression init lowers out of the loop and out of the switch IIFE,
# so an error there returns from the enclosing function before the
# next iteration and before any arm. The ejected tree builds under
# plain go with the same behavior.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m

logos run .
cp stdout $WORK/logos-stdout.txt

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
! grep '\?' out/main.go
! grep 'misplaced' out/main.go

cd out
go run .
cp stdout $WORK/eject-stdout.txt
cmp stdout $WORK/eject-stdout.txt
cd ..
cmp $WORK/logos-stdout.txt $WORK/eject-stdout.txt
cmp $WORK/logos-stdout.txt want-stdout.txt

exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/trypos

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
)

var errStep = errors.New("step")

var postCalls int
var bodies int

func next(v int) (int, error) {
	postCalls++
	if v == 2 {
		return 0, errStep
	}
	return v + 1, nil
}

func nextOK(v int) (int, error) {
	postCalls++
	return v + 1, nil
}

func sumOK() (total int, err error) {
	for i := 0; i < 3; i = nextOK(i)? {
		bodies++
		total += i
	}
	return total, nil
}

func sumFail() (total int, err error) {
	for i := 0; i < 5; i = next(i)? {
		bodies++
		total += i
	}
	return total, nil
}

func load(fail bool) (int, error) {
	postCalls++
	if fail {
		return 0, errStep
	}
	return 7, nil
}

func classify(fail bool) (string, error) {
	r := switch n := load(fail)?; n {
	case 7 => "seven"
	default => "other"
	}
	return r, nil
}

func main() {
	postCalls = 0
	bodies = 0
	total, err := sumOK()
	fmt.Println("post-nil:", err == nil, total, postCalls, bodies)
	postCalls = 0
	bodies = 0
	total, err = sumFail()
	fmt.Println("post-err:", err == errStep, total, postCalls, bodies)
	postCalls = 0
	s, err := classify(false)
	fmt.Println("init-nil:", err == nil, s, postCalls)
	s, err = classify(true)
	fmt.Println("init-err:", err == errStep, s == "", postCalls)
}

-- m/want-stdout.txt --
post-nil: true 3 3 3
post-err: true 0 3 3
init-nil: true seven 1
init-err: true true 2
